text:
Anika: kicking off FluxPay LoRA graft into release/1.2.0-serving. scope: merge sanity, nf4-int4 smoke, experimental int3 probe (kv_cache off), and a tiny 27-example quickpack focused on INR (₹) formatting, negative-parentheses accounting, and thousands separators. @Ethan can you export the prompts?
Ethan: on it  I exported FLUXPAY_prompts_full.csv and will scrub PII. I'll assemble fluxpay-quick27.json (27 cases: rupee variants, (123) negative amounts, grouping separators for en_IN and en_US). Uploading to s3 after scrub.
Rocio: small vocab/shifting note after local graft: a token index for the rupee sign moved which causes a stray empty token in very short templates. diff: ```- token 2301: "₹" -> 78
+ token 2301: "\u20B9" -> 79```
This can surface as missing leading char on outputs like "₹5" -> " 5".
Gus: customer ticket mentioned missing leading ₹ in invoice snippets. We shouldn't regenerate base tokenizer now. plan: add a token_remap in manifest and a tiny serving postprocess to normalize rupee tokens. Rocio can draft the manifest snippet?
Rocio: yes, testing a manifest patch: ```json
{"model": "fluxpay-lora-v1", "token_remap": {"79": 78}}
``` will push as manifest diff and include note about token-mismatch.
Sam: quant plan: baseline fp16 -> nf4-int4 -> int3 experimental (kv_cache disabled). metrics: EM on fields (amount,currency,date), hallucination count for fabricated amounts, human fluency flag (0/1), P50/P95 latency streaming vs sync (30-token tail), token-level perplexities, and cost delta estimate.
BenchBot: CI queued: run/eng-ml/fluxpay-smoke/3891234567 (queued). logs will post here. :robot_face:
BenchBot: run/eng-ml/fluxpay-smoke/3891234567 -> started on a100-55gb. config:
```yaml
model: fluxpay-lora-v1
base: small-sage-7b
quant: nf4-int4
kv_cache: enabled
batch: 5
max_tokens: 64
evalpack: fluxpay-quick27.json
```
Ethan: uploaded fluxpay-quick27.json to s3://redwood-evals/fluxpay/quick27_v1.json and included gold labels for amount/currency/date. link: https://s3.redwood/fluxpay/quick27_v1.json
Sam: int4 first pass (27 examples): EM-fields fp16 0.936 -> int4 0.914, fluency fp16 0.989 -> int4 0.972, P95 latency fp16 215ms -> int4 155ms, cost per token estimate -39%. observed 2 cases where parentheses-negatives lost parens and one where grouping separator changed ("1,00,000" -> "100000").
Anika: good signal. kick int3 but mark experimental. remember kv_cache: false for int3 runs per prior instability.
BenchBot: run/eng-ml/fluxpay-smoke/3891234567-int3 -> started (kv_cache: false).
Sam: int3 preliminary (first 12): EM-fields 0.83, fluency 0.88, hallucinations flagged 4/12 (fabricated or shifted amounts), P95 120ms. will run full 27 and post breakdown.
Gus: if we keep remap, add a small deterministic postprocess in serving that canonicalizes rupee token -> ensure fp16/int4/int3 don't diverge on templates. Also add a tiny detokenize regression assert in smoke jobs so product sees diffs early.
Rocio: pushed a draft manifest remap and a unit test for detokenize canonicalization to my branch. snippet in PR: ```json
{"token_remap": {"79": 78}, "notes": "map rupee token id changed by LoRA graft; do not alter base tokenizer without model-owner approval"}```
Ethan: updated quick27 with 3 adversarial cases (en_IN grouping, negative in parentheses, trailing-space rupee variant). re-uploaded as quick27_v2.json.
Sam: int3 full finished: EM-fields 0.812, fluency 0.87, hallucinations 6/27 (fabricated amounts or decimal shifts), P95 118ms. token-level perplexities + per-example diffs uploaded to /runs/3891234567/int3/summary.json.
BenchBot: run/eng-ml/fluxpay-smoke/3891234567 -> completed (status: WARN). artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/fluxpay/3891234567/artifacts.tar.gz
Anika: action items: (1) Ethan finalize quick27 with adversarial cases (done), (2) Rocio push manifest remap + unit test (wip), (3) Sam attach full artifacts and cost sheet, (4) Gus add serving postprocess assert in smoke CI. We'll review for product canary tomorrow. If int3 hallucination rate > 10% we'll not promote int3 and ship int4 with a route-level fallback to fp16 for payment-critical endpoints.
Gus: will add the detokenize normalization and a regression assert that compares fp16/int4/int3 on 12 short templates.
Sam: logs and perf traces uploaded to /runs/3891234567/artifacts/; cost estimate csv in artifacts.tar.gz.
Ethan: added a synthetic regression test for rupee/paren-normalization into tests/evals/amount_norm_fluxpay.py to gate canary.
Anika: thanks team. I'll open a small PR bundling manifest remap, the regression tests, and the CI smoke step. closing thread once PRs are green. :white_check_mark:
